description.value: The Longhorn Pub & Liquor Store is a well-established neighbourhood pub in Vernon, BC, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner alongside a full bar and Vernon's only drive-through liquor store. The venue is a lively hub for local entertainment, hosting regular trivia nights, music bingo, karaoke, and live music throughout the week. A touring cyclist stopping in will find a full pub menu with a range of food options and the convenience of a liquor store on-site.

address.value: 4513 25th Ave., Vernon, British Columbia, Canada V1T 6L3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms an active, operating pub and liquor store at 4513 25th Ave., Vernon, BC. The website consistently uses the full name 'The Longhorn Pub & Liquor Store', which differs from the OSM tag 'The Longhorn'. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('Try Us For Take-Out! Or Order on Skip!') and vegetarian options appear on the menu ('Vegetarian Trinity Omelette'). No mentions of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities were found anywhere on the site.
